items.title: eBay (NASDAQ:EBAY) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations, Guides for Strong Sales Next Quarter
items.summary: Online marketplace eBay (NASDAQ:EBAY) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 14.8% year on year to $3.13 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($3.10 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 4.1% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.60 per share was 6.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: EBay forecasts quarterly revenue above estimates
items.summary: EBay forecast third-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates on ‌Wednesday, leaning on its push into ‌authenticated luxury goods, collectibles and refurbished products to bring ​more high-value buyers to its online marketplace. The company has sharpened its focus on enthusiast buyers through "focus categories" where buyers value selection ‌and specialist ⁠services. These include trading cards and other collectibles, auto parts and ⁠accessories and refurbished electronics.
